phase: Infrastructure amendments before final scoring; rubric unchanged
changes: Two fixed final judges are gpt-6.1-sol and gpt-6-luna for every valid candidate. k3 returned 503 even to tiny health checks on both supported routes; its original failures and the first Sol judgment are retained. Both final judges are from the GPT family and candidate pool; disclose dependence and agent adjudication.

GLM uses native Chat image route with high reasoning and requested max_tokens=9000. Responses ignored limits and long transfers terminated. Other families retain Responses; all have the same 15-turn/tool/frame hard caps and requested output budget, but actual token equality cannot be guaranteed by this gateway.

GLM transport losslessly encodes PNG as WebP. Each decoded RGB byte is checked for equality, dimensions unchanged. No screenshot/video information reduction. This allowed a 12-frame preflight but larger full task requests still failed.
Additional GLM transport repair attempt was allowed after successful identical-pixel multi-image preflight; it generated no valid scored candidate and is not outcome-based trial selection.

Browser services use separate localhost ports only to avoid interference; supplied npm launcher is verified on required port3000. Exact npm CLI environment fixed by restoring PATHEXT and profile variables.
Candidate code is never edited by the evaluator. No scoring weights, criteria, or reference video changed.
